Package org.apache.juneau.config

Class EntryBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.config.EntryBuilder
public class EntryBuilder extends Object
A fluent builder for adding or updating a single Config entry.

This is an ergonomic, self-documenting alternative to the multi-argument Config.set(String, Object, Serializer, String, String, List) overload. That overload packs several distinct "leave-unchanged versus clear" sentinel conventions into one call (a null comment leaves the existing comment untouched while a blank comment clears it; a null pre-lines list leaves the existing pre-lines untouched while an empty list clears them). This builder replaces those sentinels with explicit methods:

  • Not calling a facet method leaves that facet untouched (no sentinel needed).
  • An explicit setter (comment(String), preLines(List), serializer(Serializer), modifiers(String)) sets that facet.
  • An explicit clear (clearComment(), clearPreLines()) intentionally clears that facet rather than relying on a magic blank string or empty list.

The write is performed by the terminal set(Object) or set() method. The result is identical to the equivalent Config.set(String, Object, Serializer, String, String, List) call.

Example:

// Add an entry with a comment and pre-lines. config.entry("MySection/myKey") .comment("My comment") .preLines(List.of("# A pre-line")) .set("My value"); // Update only the comment on an existing entry, leaving the value and pre-lines untouched. config.entry("MySection/myKey") .comment("Updated comment") .set(); // Clear the comment on an existing entry. config.entry("MySection/myKey") .clearComment() .set();

Notes:
  • This builder is not thread safe and is intended to be used and discarded within a single statement.

      public EntryBuilder comment(String value)
      Specifies the same-line comment to add to the entry.

      Use clearComment() to explicitly remove an existing comment.
